Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Tammy Beaumont and Danni Wyatt will open the batting. Diana Baig will begin the proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now, England Women should win this and move to 6 points. Anything other than an England win will be a shock. Also, they will look to score this off quickly. Pakistan on the other hand will need to bowl as they did in the last game. They’ll need loads of wickets at the start. Can they make a game of this? Stay tuned we will find out!

Katherine Brunt is down for a chat. She says that there is no mystery, and she has been struggling a little of late. But that is sport in general. Mentions that it was quite hard to score runs. States that she was trying to adjust pretty quickly. Concludes by saying that everybody was keen to do a job and they have done well and Pakistan are not to be underestimated.

Can’t really talk a lot about a batting line-up that has scored just 105. 7 of their batters were dismissed for a single-digit score and just two managed to cross the 20-run mark. Just a poor outing with the bat for Pakistan Women.

England Women just kept pickings wickets. Katherine Brunt set the tone by taking one on the very first ball of the game. Then there were two run-outs. Brunt then returned and got two more in her second spell. Ecclestone, Knight, and Cross also joined the party with a wicket at least to their name.

End of an excellent bowling performance by England Women! Not only have the bowlers given them a chance to win the game but to do so handsomely and improve the NRR which could come in handy later on. Knight’s decision to bowl first has paid off.

OUT! TIMBER! Sophie Ecclestone wraps the innings up! She grabs her third wicket. A loopy ball, yorker length this time, on middle. Diana Baig tried to dig this one out but she was late and she played down the wrong line and missed it completely. The ball goes on to knock the middle pole over. Pakistan Women are bundled out for 105!
Fuller ball, around middle. Diana Baig backs away and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Diana Baig taps it towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, fuller ball. Diana Baig tucks it towards square leg for a single.

In the air...and that lands just short! Length ball, around middle. Diana Baig plays across the line and miscues her heave towards mid-wicket. The fielder there runs forward and puts in a dive, but fails to reach there!
Length ball, around middle. Diana Baig blocks it out.
Length ball, angling in, on the pads. Nashra Sandhu tucks it towards square leg.
Length ball, outside off. Diana Baig swings her bat and gets and the ball goes off the outer half of the bat over cover. Single taken!
On a length, around middle and off. Diana Baig defends it out.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Nashra Sandhu leans and defends it out.
Quicker one, around middle. Nashra Sandhu defends it out.
OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Number 9 down! Outside off, flatter. Aiman looks to push at it but it goes off the outside edge to the keeper.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker, flatter, around middle. Aiman Anwer taps it towards mid-wicket.

Loopy ball, full, around off. Diana Baig gets down on her knee and looks to sweep this but the ball goes off the top edge over the keeper's head. Anya Shrubsole chases the ball down, dives, and keeps the ball away from the ropes. Three taken! 100 up for Pakistan Women!
Quicker, outside off. Diana Baig taps it towards point.
OUT! TIMBER! That is a beauty and Cross has her first. Length and on middle, Nawaz looks to push at it but this one jags back in and hits the leg pole. The last recognised batter is out.
Well fielded! Fuller and on middle, this is driven towards mid on. The fielder there dives to her left and stops it.  Only one.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Two! Outside off, this is carved past point for two.
Kate Cross (6-2-12-0) is back into the attack.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
On middle, blocked.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point.
Diana Baig walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Pakistan 7 down now! Ecclestone gets one. Sana was playing the sweep shot so well but this time Sophie drags the length back a little. She lands it outside off. Fatima Sana looks to sweep but the extra bounce sees the ball take the top edge and Jones takes a lovely catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Brilliant stop! Shorter and outside off, this is cut to point. Tammy Beaumont dives to her left and stops it. A single is taken though.
Good running! Another one floated up on off, Nawaz pushes it to cover and gets to the other end.
On off again, this is played to cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one. Good running.
Close! Outside off, Sana looks to sweep but misses.
On off, defended.
Tosses it up on off, it is pushed to mid off.
A dot to end! On off, blocked.
Angled into middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, guided to point.
Extra bounce again! On off, Nawaz looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
On off, defended.
Just short! Outside off, Nawaz looks to cut, extra bounce and hence, it goes off the top edge. Lands short of the point fielder who dives forward. A run in the end.
Sana plays the sweep as this is on the pads, through square leg for one.
And again, tossed it up nicely, lands it outside off, gets it to straighten. Sana looks to defend but is beaten.
BEATEN! Gives it nice flight. Gets it to drift away from off. Sana is beaten as she tries to defend.
The sweep is out now, it is hit through square leg for two. This stand has started off really nicely.
Two more! Outside off, this is guided through point for a couple.
A single to end! Outside off, it is guided through point.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
WIDED! Down the leg side. Jones collects it brilliantly.
Tossed up on off, it is played back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
On off, defended.
Flatter and on off, this one turns away. Sana looks to push at it but misses.
On off, this is guided to point.

FOUR! Welcome boundary and probably Pakistan should now look to go aggressive. On middle, this is swept through square leg. Dunkley in the deep, runs to her right, dives but only manages to push the ball onto the ropes.
Yet another sweep, this time she hits it through square leg and gets off the mark.
On middle, Sana sweeps but to short fine leg.
Fatima Sana comes to the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Knight comes on and strikes. On middle, Aliya looks to sweep, this time there is extra bounce. It goes off the top edge and Anya Shrubsole at short fine leg takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Anya Shrubsole b Heather Knight

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
Heather Knight brings herself into the attack now.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, Nawaz looks to flick, it goes off the pads towards square leg. Leg bye taken.
Shorter and on off, this is cut to point.
Fuller and on off, it is driven through covers for one.
This time it is played past point for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to point.
Good length and on middle, blocked.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Riaz slashes but misses.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Sciver is lucky that only went for one! Down the leg side. This is pulled towards fine leg for one.
Angled into middle, this is worked to square leg.
Good length and on off, defended.

DRINKS! The story remains the same so far! England Women continue to remain on top by grabbing wickets at regular intervals. While Pakistan Women still trying to build a partnership. They have five wickets in hand and have 20 overs remaining to put a respectable total on the board.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! This on comes in with the arm, quicker, around middle and leg. Aliya Riaz looks to tuck this but she misses. That was probably sliding down leg.
Very full on this occasion, on middle. Aliya Riaz strokes it back to the bowler.
Another fuller ball, around off. Sidra Nawaz taps it past point and scampers through to the other end.
Fuller now, outside off. Aliya Riaz leans and pushes it towards cover. Single taken!
Shorter ball, outside off. Sidra Nawaz cuts it past point for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Sidra Nawaz presses forward and defends it out.
Another length ball, outside off. Aliya Riaz pushes it towards point.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Aliya Riaz defends it out.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Aliya Riaz pushes it towards mid off.
On a length now, outside off. Aliya Riaz dabs it towards point.
Fuller, around middlle. Aliya Riaz defends it out.
FOUR! Pakistan Women need way more of these! Short and wide of off. Aliya Riaz slashes it past point. Kate Cross runs across from third man and fails to stop the ball. Boundary!
Two Wides! On a length, down the leg side. Sidra Nawaz misses her flick. Amy Jones fails to grab the ball as well. The batters sneak in a run in return!
Loopy ball, full, around off. Aliya Riaz blocks it out.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Aliya Riaz looks to push this away, but she misses. Wide given!
Fraction shorter now, outside off. Sidra Nawaz stays in her crease and cuts it past point for a single.
SLower through the air, full, on middle. Sidra Nawaz blocks it out.
Touch shorter, outside off. Sidra Nawaz chops it towards point.
Quicker this time, on middle. Sidra Nawaz blocks it out off the back foot.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Aliya Riaz gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Length, on middle. Sidra Nawaz defends it out.
Length delivery, outside off. Sidra Nawaz pushes it towards cover.
Nipping back in, around middle, tad fuller. Sidra Nawaz blocks it out.
Outside off, on a length. Sidra Nawaz dabs it towards point.
Angling in, around middle, on a length. Sidra Nawaz pushes it towards mid on.
On a length, outside off. Sidra Nawaz taps it towards cover.
Fuller again, outside off. Aliya Riaz pushes it towards cover. Good start from Sophie Ecclestone, just 3 runs off it. Not much spin though.
Fuller, loopy ball, around middle. Aliya Riaz blocks it out.
Angles this on the pads, on a fuller length. Sidra Nawaz nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Tad shorter, spinning away a tad, around off. Aliya Riaz cuts it towards point for a single.
Tosses it up, on middle, full in length. Aliya Riaz leans and defends it out.
Fullish delivery, slower through the air, around off. Sidra Nawaz pushes it towards cover for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Sidra Nawaz manages to get an outside edge between the keeper and first slip towards third man. Single taken!
Tad fuller, around middle. Sidra Nawaz pushes it towards mid off.
On a length, around off. Sidra Nawaz defends it out.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Katherine Brunt strikes once again! She has not been in her best form throughout the tournament, but she delivers today! She gets rid of a set batter now and grabs her third wicket. This one was on a length, tailing back in a tad, around off. Sidra Ameen plays inside the wrong line as she tries to cut this away, but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto the stumps. Pakistan Women lose half their side now, England Women continue to be on top! Sidra Nawaz walks out to bat now.
Fuller ball, outside off. Aliya Riaz leans to drive and gets an inside edge away from the leg pole towards fine leg for a single.
On a length, around middle. Aliya Riaz defends it out off the front foot.
Fuller now, around middle. Sidra Ameen blocks it out.
FOUR! First runs after 19 deliveries for Pakistan Women! Much-needed boundary for them. This was full, on the pads. Sidra Ameen glances it past square leg for a boundary.

NOT OUT! A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! This was on a length, angling in, around the pads. Sidra Ameen looks to flick this but she misses and gets rapped on her front pad. England Women opts for a review! UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows it is the umpire's call on wickets hitting! Sidra Ameen survives.
Pitches it up this time, around middle. Sidra Ameen drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Dot balls continue to pile up! Another length ball, around middle. Sidra Ameen pushes it towards mid on.
On a length, around middle. Sidra Ameen taps it towards point.
Fuller, outside off. Aliya Riaz defends it out. A wicket-maiden by Katherine Brunt!

OUT! LBW! Another one goes down! Katherine Brunt grabs her second wicket and Pakistan Women lose their fourth. Nida Dar walks back to the hut. A fuller ball this time, angling in, around the leg pole. Nida Dar gets down on her knee and looks to sweep this but she misses and gets rapped on her front pad. The umpire raises her finger immediately after they appeal. Nida Dar opts for a review. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved, and Ball Tracker shows it was the umpire's call on wickets hitting! Good stuff from Katherine Brunt!
Tad shorter, outside off. Nida Dar pushes it towards point off the back foot.
On a length, around middle. Nida Dar defends it out.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Nida Dar dabs it towards backward point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nida Dar pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.

An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! On a length, nipping back in, around middle. Sidra Ameen misses her flick and gets rapped on her thigh pads. Height was probably the issue here! A maiden over from Kate Cross!
Fuller now, around middle. Sidra Ameen drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Three in a row now! Shorter and outside off. Sidra Ameen does the exact same, she dabs it towards point.
Another short delivery, outside off. Sidra Ameen once again pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Back of a length, outside off. Sidra Ameen stays in her crease and dabs it towards point.
Beaten! Another length delivery, outside off. Sidra Ameen looks to push this away off the back foot, but she fails to get any bat on it.
On a length, around off. Nida Dar defends it out.
Fraction shorter now, around off. Nida Dar miscues her cut shot towards cover.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Sidra Ameen opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
On a length, outside off. Sidra Ameen dabs it towards point. No run taken!
Fuller ball, around off. Sidra Ameen presses forward and blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Nida Dar steers it towards third man for a single.
Kate Cross pulls her length back a tad, outside off. Sidra Ameen stays in her crease and taps it to point.
Fuller length delivery, outside off this time. Sidra Ameen drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Fuller ball, around middle. Sidra Ameen strokes it to mid on.
Kate Cross pitches it up now, around middle. Sidra Ameen drives it straight down the ground. The fielder from mid on will cut it out. Two taken!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Nida Dar taps it towards square and rotates the strike.
Length, around off. Nida Dar defends it out.
Much fuller on this occasion, down the leg side. Nida Dar glances it towards fine leg for a single. Another tidy over!
Another length ball, shaping away, outside off. Nida Dar hangs back and taps it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Nida Dar blocks it out.
On a length now, around the thigh pads. Sidra Ameen tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Natalie Sciver pitches it up again, around middle. Sidra Ameen pushes it with the inner half of her bat towards mid on.
Fuller ball, angling in, around off. Sidra Ameen strokes it back to the bowler.
If boundaries are not coming, such quick runs become important! Fuller and on middle, this is played to mid on for one.
Two more! Outside off, this is driven through covers for two. They need to up the ante here, they need to take more risks.
On off, kept out.
Around off, this is guided to point.
Finally a run! Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On middle, defended.
Yes, it is! Fuller and on off, this is driven firmly to mid off.
Angled into middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. Will we see two maidens in a row?
Yet another dot! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Just outside off, this is pushed to covers.
Back of a length and on off, Ameen guides it to point.
The dots continue to pile up! On off, defended.
On off, Dar pushes it to covers. A maiden by Cross.
Fuller and on off, this is driven to mid off.
On middle, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, defended.

DRINKS! What a start this has been for England Women! They grabbed two early wickets and put Pakistan Women under pressure straightaway. They were a bit sloppy in the field, but they fought back well and managed to grab their third wicket in form of a run-out. Pakistan Women were troubled early on with the swing, but they need to build a partnership from here and take things under control.
Yet another on a length and around off, kept out.
Good length and on off, Ameen guides it to point.
FOUR! That is yet another wonderful stroke! Through mid on this time! Fuller and on middle, this is timed through mid on for a boundary. Two beautiful boundaries.
Back of a length and on off, Sidra pushes it covers.

FOUR! That is a lovely shot! That is as straight as it gets without hitting the stumps at the other end. That should release a little bit of pressure. A boundary after some time. Fuller and on off, this is driven down the ground, past the stumps at the other end and for a boundary.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
A dot to end! On off, defended.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Nida Dar comes to the crease now.

OUT! Omaima Sohail is well short! Second run out. Brilliant work from Tammy Beaumont! England needed that, they were poor in the field for the last 10 minutes or so but that will make them happy. The pressure of not scoring freely has got to the two batters, they go for a risky run and pay the price. Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off and Omaima Sohail takes off. She has to run around the bowler. Tammy Beaumont runs in, picks the ball up, and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. It is taken upstairs but replays show that the dive has not saved her. A stand which was building has been broken. England continue to remain on top.
Is that a run out? There is a direct-hit at the bowler's end. Omaima Sohail's dive could not save her and she was to depart.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Right on the money to begin with! Length and on off, blocked.
Kate Cross comes into the attack.
On off, this is pushed to cover.

How has that not resulted in a wicket? That should have been Sophie Ecclestone's catch! This is fuller and on off, Sohail looks to go over the in-field on the off side but hits it up in the air between mid off and cover. Sophie Ecclestone runs forward and Sophia Dunkley runs back but both leave it for each other, in the end it lands safe. It should have been the former's catch. A single in the end. England have been poor in the last 10 minutes. Pakistan though are trying to up the ante here.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Ameen now steps down the track, Sciver lands it on a length again, it is pushed to mid off. The two just sense the urge they need to get a move on here.
On off, this is kept out.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.

Wrong end! There was a chance for another run out there! Fuller and on off, this is driven towards cover. Sohail is off for a run. Ameen waits to see if it goes past the fielder. Sophia Dunkley dives to her left and stops it but has a shy at the bowler's end which was the wrong one. No damage done in the end.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Leading edge but safe! Fuller, this tails back in. Sohail looks to flick but this goes off the leading edge over point for one.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Angled into middle now, Sohail works it to square leg.
Sohail misses out! Fuller and on off, this is driven to covers. That was there to be put away.
On off, this is defended. Just the single then from Natalie Sciver's first.
Fuller and on off, Ameen strokes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Another one which tails away but the line is well outside off, left alone.
Shorter and outside off, this is played down to third man for one.
Good start from Natalie Sciver! Angles it into the off pole and then gets it to leave the batter. Sohail looks to defend but is beaten.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Also, Natalie Sciver comes into the attack.
Fuller again and on middle, Ameen works it to mid-wicket.
Yet another one which comes back in from well outside off. It is worked down to fine leg for one.
Going down leg! This one comes back in a long way from outside off. Sohail misses her flick to get hit on the pads.
On the off pole again, this is guided to point.
Good length and on off, kept out.
Angled into the pads, it is worked to square leg.
A dot to end! A superb comeback by Brunt after going for a boundary early on. Length and on off, Ameen pushes it to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Ameen chops it to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Ameen chops it to covers.
Yet another one on a length, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Good comeback by Brunt! Length and on off, defended.
FOUR! That is timed brilliantly! Fuller and outside off, Ameen strokes it wonderfully through covers and this races away. Good start to the over.
A good over from Anya! On a length and on off, defended.
Fuller and on off, Sohail plays it to square leg.
Fuller and on off, Sohail pushes it to covers.
That is a beauty! Can't do a lot about that. That is angled in on off, it lands and moves away. Sohail looks to defend but is beaten.
Gets it to tail back in nicely but on the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
Shorter and on off, Ameen guides it to point. Anya has been a little short or a little too full. She has some problem with the landing area.
Outside off, left alone. Tidy stuff from Sohail.
Fuller this time and on middle, it is played to mid on.
That is a beauty! This moves away from off but lands and cuts back in. Sohail looks to drive but this goes past the inside edge.
Just outside off, left alone.

Three more! Edgy runs. Length and on off, shapes away. Sidra looks to defend with soft hands. It goes off the outside edge towards second slip who dives to her left and gets a hand to it. Third man runs across to her left and keeps it down to three. Sidra did not push at that one like her opening partner.
On middle, defended.
Yet another one outside off, not played at. A good over for Pakistan.
Shorter and outside off, Sohail watches it go to the keeper.
FOUR! Creamed! No stopping this one. A half volley and Omaima takes full toll of it as she freaks it through cover. No chance for Tammy Beaumont this time.
Close! Misreads the length there. Ahead of a length and on off, Sohail defends it off the back foot. Just gets her bat down in time.
Angled into middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Lovely stroke! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers. Tammy Beaumont from mid off hares after it, she dives and tries to push it back in but does not do so convincingly, the cover fielder though stops it from touching the ropes. The two save a run for their side.
Outside off, shaping away, on a length. Sidra Ameen leaves it alone. A maiden over from Katherine Brunt!
Good-length delivery, tailing back in, around middle. Sidra Ameen tries to block this but she gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Swinging in around middle, on a length. Sidra Ameen defends it out.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Sidra Ameen tucks it towards mid wicket.
Full again, outside off. Sidra Ameen drives it towards the fielder at cover once again.
Fullish delivery, outside off. Sidra Ameen pushes it towards mid off.
On a length, outside off. Omaima Sohail looks to have a poke at it but she misses.
Omaima Sohail walks out to bat now.

OUT! MAROOF IS SHORT! That is the last thing Pakistan would have wanted, their captain, their best batter being run out. That was a risk that did not need to be taken. From around the wicket, this is angled into middle. Maroof plays a little bit outside the line again. It goes off the inner half through square leg. They take one and Maroof calls for another one. Jones does brilliantly to go after the ball. Dunkley too did well to get to the stumps from covers. Amy fires it to her and she whips the bails off. It is referred and replays show Maroof is short. Pakistan in deep trouble now.
Is that a run out? There is a throw at the keeper's end. The replay shows that Bismah Maroof is short of her ground and she has to walk back!
Two! A little too straight, not the line you want to bowl with only two fielders on the leg side. It is clipped through square leg for two.
Fuller and on middle, shapes away a touch. Maroof ends up playing outside the line, it goes off the inner half to mid on.
Back of a length this time and on off, Maroof defends.
A big outswinger but it is just outside off. Left alone nicely.
A low full toss, swinging in late, on the pads. Sidra Ameen pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Shorter ball, outside off this time. Sidra Ameen stays in her crease and miscues her cut shot towards cover.
Fuller ball, tailing back in, around middle. Sidra Ameen blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Bismah Maroof tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Full this time, outside off. Bismah Maroof lunges and drives it past cover for a brace.
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Bismah Maroof tucks it towards square leg.
Full again, outside off. Sidra Ameen drives it towards mid off.
Fullish ball, around middle. Bismah Maroof clips it towards square leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sidra Ameen dabs it towards third man for a single.
An inswinger, on a length, around middle. Sidra Ameen looks to block this but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad.
Swinging in again, tad full, around off. Sidra Ameen taps it towards cover.
On a length, nipping back in around middle. Sidra Ameen looks to defend this but gets an inside edge back onto her pads.
Anya Shrubsole to bowl from the other end.
Fuller ball, outside off. Bismah Maroof taps it towards mid off. A successful first over from Katherine Brunt.

Edged...and away! Another full ball, shaping away, outside off. Bismah Maroof presses forward and looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge just away from the first slip fielder. Two runs taken! Pakistan Women are up and running!
Tad fuller, outside off. Bismah Maroof pushes it towards mid off.
Angling in again, around middle, on a length. Bismah Maroof tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Wide! Another length delivery, down the leg side. Bismah Maroof misses her flick. Wide called!
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Bismah Maroof blocks it out.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! What a start for Katherine Brunt! She strikes on her very first delivery! Pakistan Women lose a wicket very early in the innings! A perfect delivery to dismiss Nahida Khan! This was full, swinging away, outside off. Nahida Khan leans and looks to block this, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards first slip. Heather Knight takes an easy catch there!  This is a carbon copy of her dismissal against Australia. That time, the bowler was Megan Schutt, the ball was an outswinger, Nahida looked to push away from her body and got a thick outside edge to Beth Mooney at wide slip.
Commentary.Howout: c Heather Knight b Katherine Brunt

Commentary.Commentary: We are done and dusted with the pre-match formalities and we are ready for action! The players are out in the middle. Nahida Khan and Sidra Ameen will open the batting for Pakistan Women. Katherine Brunt will begin with the ball. Here we go...
All the players have lined up for the National Anthems. It will be Pakistan Women's first followed by England Women's.

Debbie Hockley is near the pitch. She says that there is a large and even coverage of grass and there is no surprise that England Women have elected to bowl, they will get a little bit out of pitch. She adds that the pitch is going to play even today and a lot of runs are expected.

Bismah Maroof the skipper of Pakistan Women, says that they would have bowled first as well, but they would like to put up a good score and defend it. Informs that they have got two changes Mentions that they need to assess the conditions and adapt well today.

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, says that they will bowl first, there is some live grass on the wicket and they are looking to exploit the conditions. Informs that they have one change, Charlotte Dean misses out. It's a tricky decision since Charlotte Dean has picked up wickets but it's a tactical decision as well. Mentions that they have not been playing their best cricket, but they are hoping to put up an all-round performance. Concludes by saying that Pakistan Women are a good side and they have beaten them before but they just have to do well today.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Sidra Ameen, Nahida Khan (In for Muneeba Ali), Bismah Maroof (C), Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Sidra Nawaz (WK), Diana Baig, Nashra Sandhu, Aiman Anwer (In for Anam Amin).

England Women (Playing XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Danni Wyatt, Heather Knight (C), Natalie Sciver, Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Kate Cross, Anya Shrubsole, Emma Lamb (In for Charlotte Dean).
TOSS - England Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Things have not gone the way Pakistan Women would have desired. They are languishing at the bottom of the table but they did manage to clinch their first victory in their previous encounter which still makes them part of the semi-final race. Their bowlers destroyed West Indies Women in their previous clash and they will want to replicate the same in today’s contest. Both teams will be looking to bring their A-game forward and this promises to be another thriller. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

The defending champions, England Women had a disappointing start to the tournament, but they pulled things back together in time and have won back-to-back games. They will be coming into this game high on confidence and will have to make three wins on the trot to keep their semi-final hopes alive.

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It’s time for yet another important clash in the Women’s World Cup 2022. It’s England Women taking on Pakistan Women at Christchurch in match number 24 of this exciting tournament. Both sides are coming into this contest with a victory in their previous game, and if they want to seal a spot in the semi-final, they will have to carry on with their winning momentum. However, only one team will be able to do so. Which team will that be? We will find out.
